item.title: GitHub Trending Digest — March 2026
item.description: Top 50 trending GitHub repos from March 2026. Dominated by the agent harness war, skills ecosystem explosion, swarm intelligence, and voice AI breakthroughs.
item.content:encoded:
The top 50 trending repositories from March 2026. This month was defined by the agent harness war — competing frameworks for orchestrating AI coding agents — alongside an explosion in skills/plugins, swarm intelligence, and voice AI.

AI / Machine Learning

openclaw/openclawTypeScript · MIT · 302k
Personal AI assistant running on your devices. Local gateway to 50+ integrations (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage). 9K to 302K stars in ~60 days — fastest-growing OSS project in GitHub history.
obra/superpowersShell · MIT · 129k
The leading agentic skills framework and dev methodology. +37,800 stars in March. Sustained multi-week trending streak.
affaan-m/everything-claude-codeJavaScript · MIT · 118k
Performance optimization system for Claude Code and related coding agents. Briefly overtook superpowers at +21,490 stars/week.
anthropics/claude-codeShell · Proprietary · 97k
Anthropic's official agentic coding tool for the terminal. +3,900 stars/day.
openai/codexRust · Apache-2.0 · 71k
OpenAI's lightweight terminal coding agent. +2,345 stars/day.
msitarzewski/agency-agentsShell · MIT · 66k
Complete AI agency with specialized agent personalities for engineering, design, sales, marketing, QA. +29,160/week peak.
unslothai/unslothPython · Apache-2.0 · 58k
Web UI for training and running open LLMs locally with dramatically reduced memory.
harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurboPython · MIT · 53k
AI-powered one-click HD short video generation.

ByteDance's SuperAgent harness for research, code, and creative tasks with sandbox execution and persistent memory.

TauricResearch/TradingAgentsPython · Apache-2.0 · 41k
Multi-agent LLM trading framework simulating a real trading firm with specialized analyst agents. Built on LangGraph.
microsoft/BitNetPython · MIT · 36k

ruvnet/RuViewRust · MIT · 34k
WiFi-based human pose estimation and vital sign monitoring — no cameras. +9,800/week.
microsoft/VibeVoicePython · MIT · 34k

fishaudio/fish-speechPython · Apache-2.0 · 28k

karpathy/autoresearchPython · MIT · 23k

RL framework for LLM reasoning and agent training.
HKUDS/ClawTeamPython · MIT · 3.4k

Runs Qwen3.5-397B MoE on a MacBook (48GB) via pure C and Metal shaders. HN buzz: 393 pts. New in March.
